title: Distributor Allocation and Purchase Order Age on Standard Endpoint Order Cancellations
content:
The build of the endpoint cancellation fee on a Hardware Procurement Standard Endpoint Order follows the age of the purchase order, counted in calendar days from the order's purchase order date to the day the cancellation is recorded.

1. A purchase order at most **1** day old has no units allocated yet, and the endpoint cancellation fee is built as **20.00 USD** for each unit ordered, with no percentage of the quote total.
2. A purchase order at least **7** days old has its units allocated or in transit, and the endpoint cancellation fee is built as the fee percentage of the quote total plus a return freight of **12.00 USD** for each unit ordered.
3. A purchase order of any other age builds the endpoint cancellation fee as the fee percentage of the quote total alone.

## Age bands

| Calendar days from the purchase order date to the cancellation day | Distributor position | How the fee is built |
|---|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | no units allocated yet | 20.00 for each unit ordered; no percentage of the quote total |
| 2 to 6 | neither band above | the fee percentage of the quote total alone |
| 7 or more | units allocated or in transit | the fee percentage of the quote total, plus 12.00 return freight for each unit ordered |

A purchase order placed on the cancellation day itself is 0 days old and falls in the first band; one placed 1 day before still does; one placed 2 days before does not. A purchase order 6 days old is in the middle band; at 7 days it enters the last band.

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Hypothetical order: 8 units, quote total 5000.00, and a fee percentage taken as 10 for the illustration.

| Purchase order age on the cancellation day | Built fee |
|---|---|
| 1 day | 8 times 20.00, that is 160.00 |
| 4 days | 10 percent of 5000.00, that is 500.00 |
| 7 days | 500.00 plus 8 times 12.00 of return freight, that is 596.00 |
